name: Electrovaya Inc.
summary: Electrovaya Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of lithium-ion batteries, battery management systems, and battery-related products for energy storage, clean electric transportation, and other specialized applications in North America. It operates infinity battery systems comprising of low and high voltage systems. The company also operates solid state battery technology.
